reviews.title: No way to stop daily reminders
reviews.text:
Update June 2026. I disconnected the app from the internet it’s sits in my phone with no convection to their services AND STOLL I GET DAILY REMINDERS.  Why do I pay for this app? To read books at my pace. I don’t need to be reminded about anything from them no 3 times a day even if I’m not connected to their servers.   They have had at least 5 updates to the app since I made my original request to make the already available button to stop the remainders work. Nothing has been done.  

If you want to be bothered 5 to 8 times a day with “remainders” please by all means pay for the app. 

 Daily reminders come at all hours of the day.  11 pm 5 am when you’re in a meeting etc.  They haves button to put them off. When you switch to off it automatically goes back to on.  I’ve contacted them since I’m ever 2025. They have done SEVERAL updates to the app since then. Unwanted reminders -several a day- come in daily.   I want my money back.  Stay away from this service unless you want your phone dinging 4-8 times a day. !

reviews.title: I love this app!!!
reviews.text: I love this app because of how much I am able to retain the information I’ve learned. I’m a neurodivergent so getting straight to the point is so helpful for me. And this app does just that. 12mins is the perfect time for a summary before my mind starts to wander off about what I’m making for dinner later. And I love the fact that there are quizzes at the end for you to test your knowledge. I’d recommend this app to anyone. Only improvement I’d say is to fix the quizzes they sometimes freeze up and the multiple choices get added to the wrong questions. Or it doesn’t go to the next question like it should. Also they could be a tad longer. For deeper testing of knowledge. But great app overall.

reviews.title: Provides both synopsis and critical review
reviews.text:
This app is helpful. It introduces new books and interesting topics. It provides both a synopsis and critical review based on their take aways. That said, it is of course subjective.

This app won’t replace what you could have learned from reading a book. Rather it can either persuade or deter you from deciding to read it.

reviews.title: Eye Opening For Further Reading
reviews.text:
12 Minute Tip is a valuable way to acquire a good perspective on a book we wish to read, but for 12 Minute Tip would have never been found. 

The theme of each book is clearly explained and gives a pertinent reason why one must read it. 

12 Minute Tip emphasizes the importance of a book and why it should be read. 

I strongly recommend 12 Minute Tip to anyone, especially those looking for a book that not only fancies them but intrigues them yet is unable to find because of the lack of knowledge or idea on how to find such a book. Indeed, this is where 12 Minute Tip comes into play and the rescue. 

Thank you, 12 Minute Tip! 

Lalo de Pilar

reviews.title: Excellent App!
reviews.text:
If you value your time like me, yet are hungry for learning and gaining knowledge, start optimizing yourself today by downloading this app! Seriously, I love audio books and this is not a complete replacement for the full book. However, in our daily, hectic busy lives it can be challenging to carve out enough time and focus to soak in a 12 hour full book. That’s where this app shines! I have only just started using it today but the time and value saved are great! I’m always eager to learn but tend to only have bite-sized chunks of time to listen to a book, with this app, I can get the whole cake in one small bite! Thank you to the team or person who made this app! I’m a big fan!
Grant

reviews.title: Quality Leadership starts with purpose and humility
reviews.text: I’ve had the pleasure of being first a team leader, then President and for over 20 years CEO of different teams (companies) and for me educating yourself is priority one! If your lucky a good employee or team member might read or seek quality information maybe once a week to once a month, but to be the team leader (i.e. Director, VP, President or CEO) your thirst for knowledge needs to be more like 3-5 per week! This app allows you to select timely topics and prepare at your schedule in order to stay on top of your game. The best part is some topics after using this app you’ll want to move on but some will bring you to greater heights!
